<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 114.068 which likely corresponds to the molecular ion (or [M+H]⁺). This mass matches the neutral formula C₉H₆ (exact mass 114.047 Da) or, if it is a protonated ion, a neutral formula of C₈H₈O (exact mass 112.057 Da) is less consistent. The simplest formula fitting the observed mass is C₉H₆, which corresponds to an aromatic, highly unsaturated compound (DBE = 9). A common structure with this formula is phenylacetylene (SMILES ‘C#Cc1ccccc1’). Therefore, the SMILES string for the sample is likely ‘C#Cc1ccccc1’.</thought>
<final_answer>C#Cc1ccccc1</final_answer>
